description:
That restaurant, recipe, article or image you stashed belongs in the conversation when you need it. Connect your Stasht account to find your saves, explore the details and compare things you're interested in.

Search with words you remember or describe what you're looking for. Browse recent or older saves and narrow your search by when you saved them. Find saved places around a location you choose, or filter saved events by date, where those details are available.

Browse your saved Stuff, collections and tags, and read your personal notes and titles. Follow connections between saved posts and the places, products, people and other things they mention. Something mentioned in a post is distinct from something you saved directly.

Ask about saved images, stored text from images, and video or audio transcripts when available. Image cards open the corresponding save in Stasht. Compare recipes using their actual saved instructions, or revisit the details behind a place you want to try. Open a result in Stasht whenever you want to pick up there.

This connection reads your library. It cannot save, edit or delete things, make bookings, check live availability, or set reminders. A Stasht account is required.

defaultPrompt: hey, what did i stash for dinner?
show me a few recent saves
help me find that restaurant i stashed
